correctness.rationale: Direct divisor arithmetic verifies all three piecewise-linear functions lie in R(D): the computed D+div values at v0..v5 are respectively psi0=(0,2,0,1,0,1), psi1=(0,3,0,2,0,1), psi2=(0,4,0,2,0,0), with the only interior midpoint order +2 for psi0. On bridge B2 the three restrictions are affine with distinct slopes 0,1,2. For arbitrary additive constants, pairwise ties occur at at most three points, so some open point has a unique minimum; hence no tropical dependence exists. Those at most three tie points divide the length-8 bridge into at most four open pieces, giving a largest unique-minimum piece of length at least 2.
